description: This file is a shell script designed to test various functionalities of the 'git am' command, including options like --retry, --3way, --no-3way, --quiet, --no-quiet, --signoff, --no-signoff, --reject, and --no-reject. It sets up git repositories, applies patches, and checks the outcomes to verify command behaviors.

methods.name: format_patch
methods.description: Creates a formatted patch file in eml format for a given commit or reference.
